title: Viktor Oddy — living portrait hero
note: A dark hero for MINA built on one trick: a large realistic portrait whose head and eyes turn to follow the visitor's cursor. His hook: every portfolio is dead (static), so he built one that looks back at you. Her version is drawn, not photoreal: her hand-drawn self-portrait with eyes that follow the cursor and an occasional blink, on About or Play, never the main hero. Free build prompt: https://motionsites.ai/?prompt=living-portrait-hero
